forceSplitScreen.title: Turn split screen on
forceSplitScreen.description: Turns the game's split screen on when the mod can find it for certain. Turn off if the game misbehaves.

separateControllers.title: One player per controller
separateControllers.description: Gives each controller its own player (the game on Android sends every controller to player 1). Turn off if controllers misbehave.

forceSplitscreenJoin.title: Let other controllers join
forceSplitscreenJoin.description: Lets a second, third or fourth controller join as a split-screen player. Turn off if the game misbehaves.

firstControllerIsPlayer1.title: First controller plays player 1
firstControllerIsPlayer1.description: Off: player 1 keeps the touch screen and every controller joins as a new player with Start. On: the first controller plays player 1.

startJoins.title: Start joins directly
startJoins.description: On: Start on a controller without a player adds a player in a loaded world (the game shows no join prompt on Android). Off: only the game's own join prompt adds players.
